description: The utility SHALL recursively enumerate files under `~/Documentos_Teste`, `~/Documentos`, `~/Downloads`, `~/Imagens`, and `/mnt` using `opendir/readdir`, and capture files with the extensions `.xlsx`, `.docx`, `.pdf`, `.txt`, `.csv`, `.jpg`, `.png`, `.db`, `.backup`, `.psd`, `.zip`, and `.rar`. The utility SHALL enumerate the target folders and delete files with the `.bak`, `.backup`, and `.old` extensions using `remove()`.
name: enumeracao_e_limpeza_de_arquivos
